name: California Apprenticeship Programs (Division of Apprenticeship Standards)
description: Earn wages while learning skilled trades with industry certification upon completion
fullDescription: California's registered apprenticeship programs, overseen by the state Division of Apprenticeship Standards (DAS), let you earn while you learn. Get paid while receiving on-the-job training and classroom instruction leading to journey-level certification.
whatTheyOffer:
- Earn wages while training, with pay increasing as your skills grow
- On-the-job training with experienced workers
- Related classroom instruction
- Industry-recognized certification upon completion
- Career pathway to high-paying skilled trades
- Programs in construction, healthcare, IT, manufacturing, and more
- Pre-apprenticeship and youth apprenticeship options
howToGetIt:
1. Search for programs with the DAS apprenticeship search tool
2. Each program lists its own minimum age, education, and other requirements
3. Some programs prefer a high school diploma or GED; others have no education requirement
4. Apply directly to the apprenticeship program as listed in the search results
5. Some programs require an aptitude or other test
6. Bay Area regional DAS office: 415-961-9852
keywords: apprenticeship, apprentice, learn a trade, earn while you learn, journeyman, union, skilled trades, vocational, certification, construction, electrician, plumber, DAS, California Apprenticeship Initiative
